chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim, from Ja'far, from his father (peace be upon them both), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) would not touch (alastilam) except the Black Stone and the Yemeni Corner, and he would kiss them and place his cheek on them. And I saw my father doing the same.

key_terms.يَسْتَلِمُ: He touches (with the hand, often followed by kissing)

ai.seo_question: What is the prophetic method of touching and kissing the stones during Hajj Tawaf?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the specific Sunnah of the Prophet Muhammad (SAW) and Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) regarding the tactile veneration of the Kaaba's corners during Tawaf. It highlights the distinction between the Black Stone and the Yemeni Corner as the primary points of contact, reflecting the Shia emphasis on emulating the Prophet's precise ritual actions. This practice underscores the spiritual significance of physical connection with the sacred architecture of the House of God.
